Game Overview

At its heart, Idle Restaurant is a restaurant game about grow your culinary empire in Idle Restaurant. Start from a street food bar, serving up a storm with intuitive tap mechanics. Scale up by hiring staff and upgrading your kitchen. Conquer challenges across multiple cities, delivering unique dining experiences and strategic thrills on your journey to restaurant fame.
